XData.name: UrlMap
XData.Description:
Pozor mapovani zalezi na poradi, bere se prvni ktere je splneno,
nejmene presne je tedy potreba vkladat nakonec
XData.Data: <Routes> <Map Prefix="/v1/cust" Forward="util.rest.custREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/record" Forward="util.rest.v1.recordREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/list" Forward="util.rest.v1.listREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/cir" Forward="util.rest.v1.cirREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/mvs" Forward="util.rest.v1.mvsREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/s3" Forward="util.rest.v1.s3REST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx/google" Forward="util.rest.v1.googleREST"/> <Map Prefix="/v1/:ictx" Forward="util.rest.v1.processREST"/> </Routes>

Method.name: OnPreDispatch
Method.Implementation:
if ('..AcceptsContentType(..#CONTENTTYPEJSON)) { s %response.Status=..#HTTP406NOTACCEPTABLE s pContinue=0 s err=##class(util.rest.v1.utils).err2Json(.env,"ERR_REST008#Accept 'application/json' only") w err q $$$OK } ;s %zarena=##class(base.arena).%New()
q $$$OK
